_doc: [onboard] The Signal Tower (story/signal_tower.gd): WREN can only reach Lumi through it. Tier 0 is the broken mast in the yard; each tier raises the relay signal (signal_pct) and WREN's clarity (Wren.stage(): tier 1 crackly, 2 clearer, 3+ clear) and unlocks the lines she couldn't send. Costs in the three currencies only. [M3-19] Cubes only (a build, not a machine); the first tier was the accepted proposal's 500. [M3-21] 100 now: the card asks for it as soon as the base has power, when Lumi still carries every bale to the scale and the bot's real income is 1 to 2 cubes a second. Dearer was a long wait with nothing bought: 128 s at 280 in one run, 123 s at 200, 174 s at 160 (docs/reviews/M3-21_PACING_FIT.md).
